messages.author: ba334c27be872358
messages.subject: LOB/LOD calculation
parts:
Dear MSstats team,

I was using an old version of the MSstats package and after updating it to the most recent version, I realized that in the version 4.2.0 there are no longer the LOB/LOD estimation functions "nonlinear_quantlim" and "linear_quantlim". 

Do you have now new alternative functions to do these estimations? If not, what are your recommandations for this type of LOB/LOD estimation using MSstats? Should I go back to using the older version of your package ?

Thank you in advance.

Best regards,
Tuvana Satar

messages.author: 5c6e92c10ef28984
messages.subject: Re: LOB/LOD calculation
parts:
Hi,



these functions are now in a separate package: http://www.bioconductor.org/packages/release/bioc/html/MSstatsLOBD.html



Kind regards,
Mateusz

messages.subject: Re: LOB/LOD calculation
parts:
Hi Mateusz,

Please find attached the input dataset that I give to the function "nonlinear_quantlim", both with MSstats 3.18.5 and MSstatsLOBD 1.2.0, and the corresponding results.
Here is how I simply call those functions in my script: 

quantlim_out <- MSstatsLOBD::nonlinear_quantlim(dataset)

or 

quantlim_out <- MSstats::nonlinear_quantlim(dataset)


meaning I use the default parameters each time. 

Thank you in advance for your help.

Best regards,
Tuvana

messages.author: 5c6e92c10ef28984
messages.subject: Re: LOB/LOD calculation
parts:
Hi,


thanks for reporting the issue, turns out both versions had minor problems that affected the output, please run this command:
devtools::install_github("Vitek-Lab/MSstatsLOBD", ref = "hotfix-loq-typo")
to install fixed version of MSstatsLOBD.



Kind regards,
Mateusz
